name: LS ELECTRIC Co., Ltd.
summary: LS ELECTRIC Co., Ltd. operates globally as a pioneering provider of advanced smart energy solutions. The company delivers an extensive range of intelligent power management technologies, which include sophisticated energy management systems, supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) platforms, and robust systems for power distribution management and control. Their offerings also extend to microgrid developments and cutting-edge diagnostic tools. For power infrastructure, their key products encompass gas-insulated switchgear, power transformers, high-voltage direct current (HVDC) solutions, various power distribution equipment, modular substations, photovoltaic (solar) power installations, and advanced energy storage systems. They also manufacture crucial components such as low and medium voltage apparatus, protective relays, precise measuring instruments, and direct current (DC) components. LS ELECTRIC is additionally a significant supplier of industrial automation technologies, offering solutions from individual devices to integrated process control systems. This includes programmable logic controllers (PLCs) for equipment command, AC drives for motor speed regulation, servo systems for accurate positioning, human-machine interfaces (HMIs) for real-time operational monitoring, and power inverters alongside gearboxes. Furthermore, the company provides intelligent rail solutions, encompassing critical signaling infrastructure and power supply networks for railways. The company, originally known as LSIS Co., Ltd., officially adopted its current name, LS ELECTRIC Co., Ltd., in 2020. Established in 1974, its corporate headquarters are situated in Anyang, South Korea.
